about: World estimate settings (tools/world_estimate.py, docs/WORLD_ESTIMATE.md). Edit the lists for your own data; cell names are matched case-insensitively.

exclusion.about: IMPORT-TEST-CELLS-31: development and test cells are not part of the game world. Default rule: an interior cell a player cannot reach (no chain of load doors from an exterior cell or from a cell that a script or dialogue result names) is left out and listed in summary.json. include_cells keeps such a cell; exclude_cells removes any cell. --exclude listed applies only exclude_cells; --exclude none keeps every cell.
